sources.title: Gemini 2.0: Flash, Flash-Lite and Pro
sources.evidence: Dated February 5, 2025; announces Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite public preview in the Gemini API, Google AI Studio and Vertex AI. Identifies it as cost-optimized for large-scale text output. Reopened October 27, 2026 for the parameter re-audit: no numeric model-size disclosure or named count-bearing base appears in the announcement.

sources.title: Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite Model Card
sources.evidence: April 10, 2025 card, PDF page 2: identifies the exact model as part of Gemini 2.0, with sparse MoE Transformer architecture, text/image/audio/video inputs, 1,048,576-token context and text output. It supplies no total or active parameter count. Fresh full-document reread October 27, 2026 confirmed that the architecture section supplies a Gemini 1.5/2.0 architecture lineage, not an unchanged named base with a published parameter count; its benchmark comparison has no size column.

sources.title: Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite | Gemini API
sources.evidence: Exact model-code page documents 1,048,576 input tokens, 8,192 output tokens, text/image/audio/video input, text output, function calling supported and thinking unsupported. Lists both the unversioned ID and -001 revision, and says shutdown occurred June 1, 2026. Reopened October 27, 2026; the exact model specifications contain no total or activated parameter count.

sources.title: Start building with Gemini 2.0 Flash and Flash-Lite
sources.evidence: February 25, 2025 announcement explicitly marks general availability of Flash-Lite. This follows the February 5 public preview and is not the earliest public release.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
sources.evidence: Later Gemini 2.X technical report includes the exact 2.0 Flash-Lite column in Table 1, maps it to gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001 in Table 2, and describes low-latency, at-scale usage. Table 1 says no thinking and no tool use; the latter conflicts with current API documentation. No model parameter count is disclosed. Fresh full-report parameter and exact-model review October 27, 2026: section 2.1 describes MoE activation and distillation for the 2.5 series, without a numeric count or a count-bearing base for 2.0 Flash-Lite. The 22-billion and trillion-parameter occurrences belong to cited vision-transformer and Switch Transformer papers, not this model.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Gemini API and AI Studio are governed by Google service terms; the restrictions prohibit extracting or replicating underlying models and parameter weights. Supports a proprietary hosted-service classification rather than an open weight license.

sources.title: Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite | Google Cloud documentation (Spanish)
sources.evidence: Exact model page, updated September 16, 2026, retains the full specifications: multimodal input, text output, function calling, no thinking, and application/pdf input up to 50 MB. Lists -001 launch February 25, 2025 and shutdown June 1, 2026. The English URL redirects to the generic model index.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Model Card, September 26, 2025
sources.evidence: Later sibling model card names 2.0 Flash-Lite in comparisons and safety tables, but reports no numeric total or active parameter count for it. Its 2.5 architecture/capabilities are not transferred to the assigned 2.0 model. Fresh full-card review October 27, 2026 reconfirmed that its exact 2.0 Flash-Lite benchmark/safety comparisons provide no parameter column or numeric count.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card
sources.evidence: October 27, 2026 later-disclosure check of the complete decoded current card: no exact Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite reference or numeric total/active count for it. This later-generation card supplies no basis for carrying a count back to the assigned model.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Safety Report
sources.evidence: October 27, 2026 later-disclosure check searched the complete report for the exact model, parameters, size and distillation. No Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite reference or numeric total/active disclosure was found; parameter mentions concern evaluation, security or encoded knowledge, while distillation describes anti-extraction controls.

developer.note: Released by Google; the model card and announcement identify Google DeepMind as the model organization.

family.note: Retains the catalog-normalized Gemini Flash-Lite lineage; the exact generation is Gemini 2.0.

release_date.note: Earliest public preview, explicitly announced February 5. February 25 is the later GA/-001 release; this unversioned model record tracks first public availability.

open_weights.note: Google distributed this model through its hosted services under service terms, without a public weight release.

license.note: Descriptive license classification for the Google-hosted model. Website documentation and sample-code licenses are not model licenses.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27, 2026 exact-model and exact-ID count/lineage searches, original model card and API page, and later first-party report/card comparisons found neither a numeric total count nor an explicit unchanged base with a published count. The card describes an architectural lineage; the 2.5 report discusses later-series distillation. Neither establishes a count for 2.0 Flash-Lite. Retain null rather than adopting an estimate or a sibling/teacher count.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27, 2026 original and later primary-source review found no activated-per-token count for the exact sparse MoE model. The comparison tables supply capabilities and benchmark results, not active parameters. No expert routing or named-base disclosure supports deriving a count; retain null independently of total parameters.

architecture.note: The exact model card architecture section identifies sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer architecture and explicitly includes Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite.

context_window.note: Exact input/context limit in tokens; output limit is separately documented as 8,192.

modalities.note: Four input modalities and text output are explicit. PDF is retained as the catalog document-input category: the exact Cloud model page lists application/pdf support.

reasoning.note: No dedicated thinking capability. This flag does not claim the model cannot solve reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: The current exact API and Cloud specification pages explicitly support function calling. The older report Table 1 says no tool use; retain last-documented function calling rather than treating that historical table as the final API specification. Native search grounding and code execution remain unsupported.

description.value: Cost-efficient Gemini 2.0 model for high-volume, low-latency multimodal input and text output.
description.note: Replaces the broad agent-workload description with directly documented cost, latency, scale and input/output scope.

patch.description: Cost-efficient Gemini 2.0 model for high-volume, low-latency multimodal input and text output.
patch.notes: First public preview: February 5, 2025; GA followed February 25. Sparse MoE Transformer; total and active parameter counts are undisclosed. Google documents shutdown on June 1, 2026; capabilities describe the last documented specification.

evidence_checks.later_disclosure_review: Fresh October 27, 2026 re-audit reopened the exact April 2025 card and API page, inspected all parameter occurrences and exact-model tables in the full Gemini 2.5 technical report and September 2025 Flash-Lite card, and checked the current Gemini 4 Argon card and full Gemini 4 safety report. None supplies a numeric total or active count for Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite; the Gemini 4 sources do not name this exact model. Independent searches covered the marketing name, gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001, total/active counts, billions, base-model lineage and distillation. No accepted numeric disclosure emerged.
evidence_checks.architecture_review: The exact 2.0 Flash-Lite card supplies direct MoE Transformer evidence. Additional exact-name interpretability/training searches on Google DeepMind and arXiv did not identify a contrary architecture disclosure.
conflicts: Older technical-report Table 1 marks tool use No; current exact API and Cloud pages mark function calling supported. The retained true value describes the last documented API capability.
English Cloud model URLs redirect to a generic index; the fully accessible Spanish exact-model documentation retains specifications and identifies the same model code.
evidence_checks.cache: Evidence is retained in this report as source URLs, page/table locators and paraphrases; no separate repository evidence files were written.
evidence_checks.parameter_lineage_review: The original card says the 2.0 series builds upon Gemini 1.5 sparse MoE architecture with refinements; it does not identify an unchanged count-bearing checkpoint. Section 2.1 of the 2.5 technical report discusses distillation for the 2.5 series, not a published count for 2.0 Flash-Lite. Price, speed, generic architecture, teacher size and sibling size were not used as substitutes for a count.

summary: Fresh parameter-only re-audit completed October 27, 2026. Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite total and active parameters remain null/undisclosed after exact-name/ID searches, renewed original evidence inspection, and later first-party comparison/report checks. Neither a nominal numeric count nor an explicit count-bearing unchanged base was found. Both nulls are explicit in the patch; unrelated field assessments are preserved.
